newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-BRESCIA PROMOTED TO ITALY'S SERIE A.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRESCIA PROMOTED TO ITALY'S SERIE A.

text.p: Brescia clinched promotion to Italy's serie A on Sunday with one match of the season remaining after drawing 1-1 with Reggina in Reggio Calabria.
The remaining three promotion places will be decided next weekend, with Empoli, Lecce, Bari and Genoa in contention.
Cosenza, Cesena, Palermo and Cremonese have been relegated from serie B to serie C.
